hard_numeric_fact_text: FACT (web-reported, consistent across Business Today/Kotak Neo/ICICI Direct): order book Rs7.79 lakh cr at 30 Jun 2026 (+27% YoY), Q1 inflow Rs1.08 lakh cr (+14%) vs Q1 consolidated revenue Rs67,942 cr (+7%). The 5-7 Oct 2026 NSE filings give no order values: the 7 Oct Chandrapura 2x800 MW thermal award is only a Limited Notice to Proceed (NTP awaits environmental clearance), counted at 50% haircut. The dossier's per-filing 'value_cr=306,432' is an extraction artefact and is NOT used.

bear.assumptions: Middle East awards slip, EBITDA margin stays ~8-9%, execution under-delivers FY27 10-12% revenue guide, derates to 22x

base.assumptions: Revenue +10-12% per guidance, PAT ~+12% CAGR, other income normalises, multiple ~27x

bull.assumptions: Execution normalises H2 FY27, PPM margin recovers toward 7.8% target, 32x

extreme_bull.assumptions: Offshore wind, data-centre and semiconductor optionality re-rate

risk.order_firmness: MEDIUM: Oct filings include LNTP (not NTP); Middle East awards lumpy

thesis: Rs7.79 lakh cr record order book and unchanged 10-12% FY27 guidance, but L&T is a Rs4.99 lakh cr mega-cap at ~31x TTM P/E where the chain breaks at operating leverage: Q1 revenue +7% was below guide, EBITDA fell ~3% with margin 9.0% (from 9.9%), PPM margin 7.0% vs 7.8% target, and PAT growth leaned on other income (+75%). October filings are routine order flow (one LNTP without disclosed value). Widely covered, not an early inflection; EV ~+20% fails the starter bar.
chain_missing_links: Operating leverage (EBITDA down YoY, margin down ~90bp)
Early-stage: order flow is already in consensus
demand_signal: Order book +27% YoY, Q1 inflow +14%, ~Rs15 lakh cr near-term pipeline (MANAGEMENT CLAIM)
pricing_signal: No evidence; Q1 margin compression attributed to lower execution, forex in IT subsidiaries and higher ECL provisions (MANAGEMENT CLAIM)
order_book: Rs7.79 lakh cr at 30 Jun 2026 (+27% YoY); Oct 2026 filings: PT&D mega orders (value undisclosed in filing, Saudi/UAE/Vizag), Chandrapura 2x800 MW LNTP (value unknown), Dubai twin contracts (one large, one significant, completion end-2028)
capacity_catalyst: L&T Semiconductor Technologies unveiled 40 products at SEMICON (18 Sep filing, text not extracted); revenue contribution unknown
debt: ND/EBITDA 3.2 consolidated per dossier (includes financial services); interest cover 11.3
valuation: Dossier TTM P/E 30.7, EV/EBITDA 18.2, market cap Rs4.99 lakh cr. Dossier conflict: dossier latest-quarter revenue -8.7% YoY, EBITDA -25.4%, PAT -25.0% vs web-reported Q1 FY27 revenue +7%, PAT +14% (Rs4,123 cr); dossier EBITDA margin 9.0% matches. Web figures preferred; unresolved.

plausible.2x: NO: needs EPS ~Rs200 at 36x by FY29, roughly +30% EPS CAGR vs ~12% guided
plausible.3x: NO: would need ~Rs300 EPS at 36x; not credible for a Rs5 lakh cr EPC conglomerate

kill_conditions: FY27 order inflow or revenue guidance cut below 10%
Consolidated EBITDA margin below 8.5% for two consecutive quarters
Middle East awards not resuming by Q3 FY27
LNTP projects (Chandrapura) not converting to NTP within 12 months
biggest_risk: Derating from ~31x TTM P/E if execution and margins keep slipping while other income fades.
next_datapoint: Q2 FY27 results: revenue growth vs 10-12% guide, EBITDA/PPM margin, other income share of PBT, Middle East inflow
